text:
Type: slipcovered three-seat sofa
Use: seating, lounging; living room, family room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: removable striped fabric slipcover, soft loose cushions
Colors: dusty pink, warm red, cream, sage green pinstripes
Shape: rounded rolled arms, three loose back and seat cushions, vertical stripes, skirted base hiding the legs, deep and bulky
Feel: cheerful, cozy, homey
Goes with: white walls, painted or light wood, cream and red textiles; farmhouse, cottage or coastal living rooms

product.name: EKTORP
product.description: Seat cushions filled with high resilience foam and polyester fibre wadding give comfortable support for your body, and easily regain their shape when you get up.
